description: Data acquisition stack used to record the time series in data/raw_data/. Every raw CSV row is one sample emitted by the SCADA at the listed cadence.

scada.name: Panorama E2
scada.role: real-time data acquisition, PID control of the cold-head heater (TT008), and safety supervision
control_loops: TT008 inlet temperature regulation via PID acting on Q008 with a safety thermal switch

temperature_acquisition.role: reads the Cernox resistances and converts them to TT101 and TT102 via the calibration polynomials in data/cernox_calibration_data/
temperature_acquisition.expanded_uncertainty_k2_mK_range: 1.3 mK at 20 K to 13.1 mK at 180 K (polynomial fit; see calculate_jt_coefficients.TempUncertainty.get_cabtr_uncertainty)

pressure_acquisition.transport_to_scada: RS-232 forwarded through a Modbus gateway

composition_acquisition.transport_to_scada: RS-232 forwarded through a Modbus gateway
composition_acquisition.operating_pressure_MPa: atmospheric (sensor placed at the system outlet)

sampling.format: CSV, one file per campaign day, header in the first row
sampling.averaging_for_steady_state: five consecutive 1 s samples averaged at each steady-state measurement window; window timestamps are listed in data/raw_data/extraction_windows.json
